programme.desc: Tras descubrir que la escena de un espeluznante asesinato había sido montada, el equipo se da cuenta de que Abby era el objetivo previsto cuando unas pruebas clave contaminan su laboratorio y casi la matan.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Ziva queda en estado de shock cuando una táctica rutinaria que utiliza para someter a un sospechoso podría ser la causa de su repentina muerte. Mientras Ducky y Abby trabajan para limpiar el nombre de Ziva.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Los miembros del NCIS se angustian cuando Gibbs resulta herido en una explosión terrorista durante una misión.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Mientras el equipo intenta localizar a los terroristas que están detrás del atentado que hirió a Gibbs, se enteran de que el grupo terrorista está planeando otro atentado de la magnitud del 11-S, y que Gibbs tiene información sobre su plan.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: El pecado de los padres
programme.desc: Frank busca pruebas contra un sospechoso de matar a un policía que disparó a un compañero de Henry hace años. Danny y Baez investigan una serie de asesinatos relacionados con estrellas de cine para adultos.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Equipaje
programme.desc: Danny se siente desconcertado cuando descubre que un grupo de veteranos del ejército altamente entrenados son responsables de un robo.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Hogar dulce hogar
programme.desc: Jamie involucra a Danny cuando encuentra a un adolescente sin hogar que afirma que su tía fue asesinada por su novio. Mientras tanto, Erin se enfurece cuando McCoy la reemplaza como fiscal en un caso que involucra a un guardia de prisión.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Historias de amor
programme.desc: Danny y Maria investigan cuando un propietario dispara a un intruso, solo para descubrir que el intruso es un sicario. Además, un joven abogado intenta hacer justicia para su madre, a quien Erin envió a prisión por un cargo de asesinato hace 12 años.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Una serie de secuestros dirigidos cerca de Memphis tiene la BAU en busca de una coincidencia entre las personas desaparecidas y un motivo que les llevará al sospechoso.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Cuando las víctimas son encontradas muertas por envenenamiento con arsénico en Long Beach, California, amenazas de muerte escritas a mano y otras pistas hacen que la UAC busque a un sujeto fascinado con la mitología griega.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Cuando la UAC es llamada a Texas para realizar consultas sobre los asesinatos de prostitutas, la evidencia apunta a asesinatos con connotaciones religiosas. Pero a medida que profundicen en la investigación, el equipo podría poner en riesgo sus vidas.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: La UAC continúa su investigación de asesinato en Texas y las pistas descubren una profunda red de corrupción que podría ser el motivo de los asesinatos.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Arturo va a Barranquilla y conoce a Miriam, quien roba sus pertenencias. Al llegar a Barranquilla, Arturo consigue que un empresario musical lo contrate. Leandro logra recuperar la confianza de los tocaimeros y termina la canción dedicada a ellos.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: En la cárcel, Leandro se desahoga con su compañero de celda. Miriam se acerca a Matilde con dudosas intenciones. Chico saca a Leandro de la cárcel y se encuentran con Matilde. Moisés se entera de que Matilde está con Leandro y la sigue.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Moisés logra que Matilde Lina regrese con él, sin embargo, en el camino ella se arrepiente y le pide que la lleve a donde su hermana. Leandro no logra avanzar con su canción para Matilde.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Reinaldo y Leandro llegan a San Diego, y las hermanas de Reinaldo se pelean la atención de Leandro. Onofre se ve abatido por la ceguera de su hijo Urbano y Nacha lo confronta. Erótida se separa de Tomás y lo aconseja para que busque su felicidad.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Se arma una parranda en la que tocan Hugues Arango, Leandro y Reinaldo. En medio de la fiesta, Corina le revela sus intenciones a Leandro. Matilde se sincera con Moisés, por lo que decide regresar y contarle sobre su embarazo, pero quiere separarse.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario regresa a Colombia y es bien recibida por todos sus compañeros. Por otro lado, el doctor Javier Macías le dice a Don Carlos que deben liquidar el bar cuanto antes para poder asumir las deudas que tiene.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Los muchachos de la manada intentan encontrar la forma para salvar el bar Garibaldi y dentro de esta búsqueda Rosario descubre que el culpable de esta crisis financiera es el Doctor Macías. Por otro lado, llega el día del juicio de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Al enterarse de la condena que tendrá que asumir Emiliano por unos crímenes que no cometió, Sigifredo y Fernando le escriben un correo electrónico anónimo al comandante Salas, comentándole que está cometiendo una gran injusticia.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Con dolor en sus corazones, los mariachis del bar Garibaldi se despiden. Rosario vende el traje de su papá para pagar la deuda que tiene con Javier Macías. Por otra parte, el comandante Salas decide reabrir la investigación del caso de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Han transcurrido varios meses desde el cierre del bar Garibaldi. Los integrantes de la manada no la pasan bien en sus nuevas vidas. Por otro lado, el Comandante Salas visita a Emiliano para decirle que ya sabe toda la verdad de su caso.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Las autoridades capturan a Miguel Corona y sus socios. Emiliano y Felipe recobran su libertad. Por otra parte, un empresario mexicano reabrirá el bar plaza Garibaldi.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes sigue grabando nuevas canciones para su próximo álbum. Diomedes se acuesta con Consuelo en su apartamento. Betsy da a luz y nace una linda niña. Lucia y Betsy hablan sobre Diomedes, Lucia le aconseja que no le de tanta libertad a Diomedes.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Betsy en la discoteca es retenida por el pluma blanca pues el hombre llega a rumbear y manda a cerrar las puertas. Betsy llega tarde a la casa y se le arma un problema con Diomedes. Diomedes sufre un infarto y es trasladado a un hospital a Bogotá.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Consuelo va a buscar a Diomedes al hospital y lo encuentra besándose con Betsy y se pone muy mal. Consuelo se hace pasar por una enfermera y entra a la habitación de Diomedes en el hospital. Él queda encantado con lo que hizo Consuelo por él.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: El mono recorre sus pasos, se despide de Beatriz y se muere dejando a la familia Arjona destruida. Consuelo descubre que está embarazada y le da la noticia a Diomedes, quien se alegra y le canta una canción.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes en una de sus presentaciones defiende a Nicolás, un vendedor ambulante de discos piratas que casi es encarcelado por seguridad. Nicolás está agradecido con su ídolo por salvarlo.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Elvira recorre la ciudad con su hijo, ella se siente mal y Diomedes decide no ir a ningún lado y quedarse con ella. El Pluma Blanca llega al apartamento de Diomedes y arma una fiesta a la que llegan Claudia y Consuelo, que se miran con resentimiento.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Alejandro Villa Ruiz, el empresario que compró el bar Plaza Garibaldi, reúne a todos los integrantes del grupo de mariachis para hablarles sobre sus contratos. Además el empresario va en busca de don Carlos Malagón para proponerle que sea su socio.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano aparece por sorpresa vestido de Mariachi y con varias canciones le recuerda a Rosario que ella es la mujer de su vida. Emiliano y Rosario ahora podrán disfrutar de ese sentimiento que por las injusticias de la vida tuvieron que retener.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano otorga grandes regalos a todas aquellas personas que en su paso por Colombia lo ayudaron. Por otro lado, llega la noche esperada por todos, la velada en la que el Bar Plaza Garibaldi abrirá nuevamente sus puertas al público.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: A ritmo de ranchera, la reinauguración del Bar Plaza Garibaldi es toda una fiesta en la que Emiliano, el Coloso y Rosario deleitan al público. Terminada la reinauguración del bar, Emiliano Sanchez Gallardo y su amada viajan a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano y Rosario se preparan para presentar a sus familias y formalizar su unión en compañía de sus amigos mariachis. Lo que parecía ser la noche perfecta para esta pareja de enamorados, podría convertirse en un mal momento.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Luego de darse cuenta de su equivocación al dudar de la fidelidad de Rosario, Emiliano comienza a planear la manera de enmendar su error. Sus amigos y familiares deberán ayudar al mariachi a recuperar a la mujer con la quiere compartir su vida

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario coge un taxi para llegar a San Roque. Arrestan a Fernando y lo llevan con el resto del grupo de mariachis. En la comandancia interrogan a todo el grupo. Mientras tanto, El Coloso y Emiliano hacen las paces y se despiden en San Roque.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario logra alcanzar el bus en el que se transporta Emiliano. El capitán Bernal hace repartir un volante con la foto de Emiliano Sánchez Gallardo en la que ofrecen una recompensa de treinta millones de pesos.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones investigate the cloistered world of Midsomer Priory when a nun is strangled to death. programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When MATTHEW DRAPER, a quarry worker is killed by a demolition charge after obeying the orders of his foreman, IAN FRASER, to return to the unexploded device, no one can predict how it might effect the tranquil village of Fletcher's Cross nine years later...

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby's aunt, Alice Bly (Phyllis Calvert), has an addiction to detective stories, a deep admiration for her favourite nephew, and is recovering from an operation at the Lawnside Nursing Home. When a resident dies, Alice Bly picks up gossip which, mixed with the detective fiction with which she is passing the hours, makes her think that all is not as it should be at Lawnside.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village of Midsomer Mallow is one of the villages hoping to win the title of the "Perfect English Village" competition. As the story unfolds, not everything is "perfect" as local thief Peter Drinkwater is stabbed with a pitchfork at an abandoned farm, he's using as a squat. Shortly after robbing a retired actor's home. Despite the villagers' best efforts to keep the murder quiet so as to not ruin their chances in the competition, several further deaths occur eventually bringing Detective Chief Inspector Barnaby back several decades to uncover the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst the Upper Marshwood hunt assemble outside the village inn, a filthy tramp-like man leaves the shop and skulks into the wood. Soon after, he hears the sound of the hunt begin and the unforgettable noise of the horses and hounds in hot pursuit of the fox. Running for cover, towards the safety of his home-made shelter, he stumbles and falls into a pit - screaming. LIZA, isolated in the disused railway carriage which constitutes her home, moves deeper into the wood having heard the scream. She finds the pit and sees the tramp lying crumpled on the ground, clearly dead. She stares at him for a moment, then turns and walks away.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A disused airfield near Morton Fendle is the location for a romantic evening between young Simon Bright and his girlfriend Laura Sharp - absolutely nothing could ruin their date. The next morning, when Frances Kirby is out for her morning jog, she notices the vintage car they were in up at the airfield, containing Simon Bright's dead body, with Laura nowhere to be seen. Confused, Detective Chief Inspector Barnaby and D.S. Jones can't work out whether it was a suicide pact or murder. Furthermore, they've got to find Miss Sharp and their investigation leads them to linking Simon and Laura with the villagers of Morton Fendle, who met at Elaine Trim's dancing classes. Eventually, the Barnaby family plus Jones make it to a 40s style dance night at the village hall before more villagers start turning up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer County to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters, she gets a shock - Rex's staff had been told that she was dead. Things become even more complex when Rex's body is found in a nearby river, bearing wounds that suggest he was murdered. Barnaby and Jones are soon on the case, trying to establish who would have wanted the elderly man dead. Several people soon come forward with multiple wills, which confuse the matter, but when two more people, close friends of Rex, are also murdered, the investigation raises question on the motive, leading Barnaby to wonder if it was down to finances, passion, or something from Rex's past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Following the death of Alan King while on a business trip to China, the family company, King's Crystal, is in financial trouble. As plans to shut the Midsomer Magna factory are being put into action, Alan's wife Hilary and brother Charles are married in the village church - much to the dismay of Alan's son Ian. In addition to strife between members of the family, the factory workers are outraged at the loss of their jobs. So when company accountant Peter Baxter is found murdered, Barnaby and Jones suspect a disgruntled employee is to blame. But in order to investigate the matter further, Jones is forced to work undercover, and infiltrate the local group of Freemasons in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The music lovers of Midsomer County are delighted when a host of bands arrives for the Midsomer Rocks festival. Barnaby himself is particularly looking forward to seeing recently re-formed rock band, Hired Gun, perform on stage, but he soon gets close to the band for rather unfortunate reasons. During their opening performance, the band's singer, Mimi (Suzi Quatro), falls to the ground dead - electrocuted by a wire that had been run through the microphone stand. Barnaby and Jones soon find the rest of the band could be targets, and when another is killed, questions are raised as to whether former band member, Ginger Foxton, who went missing for 30 years and is presumed dead, is still at large. The detectives soon have to delve into a world of rock music, drug use and greed, to find the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The suspicious death of popular young GP Dr Alan Delaney brings Barnaby and Jones to Midsomer Market to investigate. The detectives are baffled as to a motive for murder - until they consider that the newly engaged Dr James Kirkwood may have been the intended victim. Before long, Barnaby and Jones are heading to Wales - former home to Delyth Mostyn, James's fiancee, to delve deeper into the mystery. There are certainly possible suspects in the murder and attempt on Kirkwood, from Delyth's children, who oppose the engagement, Delyth's husband, and more, as the detectives investigate things, in hopes of uncovering the truth before a major walk is to take place on Mount Snowdon.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the build-up to Luxton Deeping's annual photographic exhibition, a battle rages between the traditional and digital photographers of the pretty village. The dispute seems harmless enough - until Lionel Bell is found murdered in a nearby woodland, strangled with the cord of his light meter. Barnaby soon gets to work tracking down the killer, but it seems someone is trying to implicate the detective in the murder. And once he is replaced on the case, finding the culprit seems less likely than ever, as his replacement is more concerned of an upcoming wedding than the investigation. Barnaby is forced to work off the case to uncover who is framing him, and who wants dead other photographers in the village.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh

Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves.As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field.With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.desc: Kerstin Forsberg has devoted her life to protecting Manta Rays in her native country of Peru. This magnificent species migrates here every year but is under serious threat from fishing in the region. With her organization, Planeta Oceano, Kerstin is engaging with the local community to ban harmful fishing practices and to include conservation in the local school curriculum, to ensure the future of the Manta Ray in Peru for centuries to come.

programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.desc: Sloths – famous around the world for their slow pace of life – are under threat. In Suriname, their numbers are falling at a staggering rate as their forest habitat is transformed into towns and roads. Since 2005, Monique Pool, nicknamed the Sloth Lady, has been working tirelessly to protect this unique species with a shelter for injured sloths and an area of forest protected from development to ensure that the local sloths have a safe place to live. Get up close with this amazing animal as she rescues sloths from urban areas, nurses injured sloths back to full health and releases them back into the forest.

programme.title: Eco-Heroines
programme.desc: Uncommon and hardly known, today the Dugong is the most threatened sea mammal on the planet. The species can only be found in certain parts of the Indian Ocean and in the western regions of the Pacific. Off the coast of Mozambique, in the Bazaruto archipelago, Karen is on a mission to monitor this species and implement policies to bring it back from the brink of extinction.

He even won an Emmy for his work writing on The Ellen Degeneres Show. His clean and clever comedy landed him on Letterman, The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, The Bob & Tom Radio Show, Sirius/XM Radio and more. The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. programme.desc: Un par de amigas de 10 años, deciden preparar un veneno para las hadas, ya que una de ella se siente bruja.

programme.desc: Un burócrata desempleado y cuatro amigos viajan a Las Vegas para asaltar un casino.

programme.desc: Jóvenes se encuentran atrapados en un mundo de drogas y crímenes del que es casi imposible escapar.

programme.desc: Un joven distraído es apresado con falsos cargos porque al cacique de la región le gusta su novia.
